summary: Sharpened the second investigation: the same failed-StoreLogs window that leaves the cached log certificate stale also wedges the follower, because the entry loop trusts the cached last index and returns on GetLog errors for the just-deleted indices, while the leader's reject branch floors nextIndex and re-sends the identical request; added the three supporting anchors and two behaviors, with the wedge explicitly marked as a source-derived prediction for the deferred harness.
